notes: All records require independent fee, geography, and AI policy review. AI compatibility is not inferred from silence. Lithuanian Journal of Statistics explicitly addresses writing and data collection/analysis AI use in its journal policy; its full applicability still requires dedicated review.

IMS explicitly characterizes contributions as voluntary, notwithstanding amounts displayed on its funding form: https://imstat.org/shop/publication-charge-funding-form/. Do not generalize this to other IMS journals.
Open Statistics instructions are dated 2021; verify current terms and operational status before relying on them. AADM does not expressly establish a zero submission fee on the inspected page.

Journal of Statistical Software already appears in the baseline and was not repeated. Excluded Journal of Applied Mathematics (Wiley): official policy specifies an article publication charge https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/4185/homepage/open-access .
